# 888lots.com

> 888 Lots is a leading US-based B2B liquidation platform for resellers with a valid resale certificate. From our warehouse in Linden, NJ, we provide manifested lots and individual items from top brands like Nike, Loungefly, and Free People, supported by powerful profitability tools for Amazon FBA sellers.

As seen on CNN, we are a primary destination for professional resellers searching "888lots," "wholesale," and "liquidation." Our platform offers unique features like pre-purchase Amazon restriction checking and live profit calculation.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://888lots.com/): The main hub for all our wholesale and liquidation deals.
- [All Items](https://888lots.com/items) → [Markdown Version](https://888lots.com/items.md): Browse over 47,000 individual wholesale products.
- [All Lots](https://888lots.com/lots) → [Markdown Version](https://888lots.com/lots.md): View all available manifested lots for resellers.
